titolo: Jensen Huang: Trump Says Yes, Nvidia's Board Reportedly Says No
angolo: A split in Washington: Trump is open to Huang's return, Bessent wants an outsider, the board reportedly refuses, and Nvidia reports earnings tomorrow without him.
descrizione: Jensen Huang: Trump Says Yes, Nvidia's Board Reportedly Says No. The FT reports Huang is weighing a comeback, and Trump says he would not mind. CNBC and CBS report, citing anonymous sources, that the board is not considering it while it runs an investigation. Nvidia stock fell about 4% on Monday and the company reports results Tuesday under interim CEO Colette Kress. Subscribe: this story is still moving.

scene.testo: Monday. Nvidia's board is reportedly not considering bringing Jensen Huang back, a source told CNBC.

grafica.sotto: Board reportedly not discussing his return

scene.testo: Nvidia shares fell about four percent. The company reports earnings tomorrow.
But President Trump said something very different on Monday.
Can a founder come back when the board reportedly opposes it, the Treasury Secretary wants an outsider, and the president is open to it?
Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia and ran it for thirty-three years, until he resigned last Thursday.
Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO. Board chair Harvey Jones said the board expects operations to continue without interruption.

citazione.testo: I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years

scene.testo: Huang resigned after revelations of an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies reportedly suspect of spying for China, according to CBS. The board said it has no reason to believe national security was compromised.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants an outsider as CEO, and says he wants answers from the board and outside counsel within ten days.
President Trump said he 'would not mind' Huang returning.
Elon Musk is backing the petition, now near 180,000 names. Nvidia's board has independent directors who can replace the CEO.

citazione.testo: A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen, and I'm signing it too.

scene.testo: Some Wall Street analysts call his return a long shot, though others are divided. Subscribe, because this story is still moving.
